Full Resort & Room Tour: Disney's Coronado Springs Resort | Walt Disney World
Take a complete tour of Disney's Coronado Springs Resort at Walt Disney World Resort! From the stunning Gran Destino Tower and spacious guest rooms to the relaxing pools, unique dining locations, and beautiful lakeside setting, we're exploring everything this popular Disney Resort hotel has to offer.

Along the way, we'll share resort amenities, recreation offerings, shopping locations, dining recommendations, and tips to help you plan your stay at Disney's Coronado Springs Resort.

Whether you're considering Coronado Springs for your next Walt Disney World vacation or simply want to explore one of Disney's most beautiful resort hotels, this guide has you covered.
